Guards storage_service::decommission rejecting non-NORMAL operation mode (originally CASSANDRA-8741). Runs in gating (next-dtest-tablets / consistent-topology).

TestNodetool::test_seed.description: Params decommission/kill. 4-node cluster (DC1: RAC1 x2, RAC2, RAC3); 60s cassandra-stress write (RF=3, exponential retry) with node1 (first node/seed) as contact point; once data appears, node1 is decommissioned or killed; asserts c-s finishes successfully. Reproducer for scylladb#2090 (c-s stopped writing when seed node removed; closed 2019 as not reproducible).
